_README: The model seam's routing table (clients/_yourco-template/model.py). Task -> ordered candidates.
The first candidate that returns text wins; the rest are failover.
THIS FILE IS THE UPGRADE POINT. When a better model ships, edit it here and the whole
client OS moves — that is what makes CLAUDE.md's 'model-upgrade dividend' literally true
instead of aspirational. Per-engagement copies live at clients/<name>/model-routing.json.
Cost routing is a margin lever, not a nicety: yourco absorbs 100% of token spend, so a
mechanical task pointed at a flagship model is money off our own margin. Match the model
to the judgment the task actually requires — and per learnings/ops/2026-08-09, if the task
has a deterministic answer, don't route it here at all: write the function.
'effort' (anthropic) controls depth/cost on current Claude models. Do not add temperature,
top_p, top_k or a thinking budget — current models reject all four.

_notes.judgment: Real reasoning a human would otherwise do — audit findings, scoping, anything the client acts on.
_notes.draft: Bulk writing under supervision. Sonnet first; Opus is the failover, not the default.
_notes.classify: Label / route / score against fixed criteria. Cheapest model that holds quality.
_notes.extract: Pull structured fields out of documents. Same posture as classify.
_notes.longcontext: Large or multimodal inputs. Gemini is already in the stack (Sample Client Design Studio image generation).
_notes.images: NOT routed here — image generation has a different response shape. See clients/sample-client/platform/server.py.
_notes.on_adding_a_task: Add the route, add a _notes line saying what judgment it needs, and point the caller at the task name — never at a model.
